lead: Wasim Akram is a widely followed Pakistani cricketer, born on 3 June 1966 in Lahore.
As of 2026, he is 60 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He has represented Pakistan national cricket team and Hampshire County Cricket Club and has been recognised with Wisden Cricketer of the Year and Pride of Performance.
Below you will find a verified overview of Wasim Akram: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.
